# FAIR-bioHeaders in JavaScript

> Native JavaScript (Node.js) reader, validator and stripper for FAIR-bioHeaders metadata headers: FHR in reference-genome FASTA and GFA, FHP in protein FASTA, FHGFF3 in GFF3. It parses the `;~`/`#~` YAML header block, recomputes the SHA-512/256 checksum of the file's exact bytes, selects the JSON Schema contract the record cites (draft 2020-12) and validates against it, and can take the header out again so strict tools accept the file. No Python, no WebAssembly, no CPython-under-Pyodide: every check runs on Node's own `crypto`, `zlib` and `ajv`.

Key facts (this library implements the contracts released in FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification **v0.6.0**; it has no release, no npm publication and no version of its own — `package.json` says `0.0.0`):

- Schema versions it validates against: FHR `schemaVersion: '2.1'`, FHP `'1.2'`, FHGFF3 `'1.2'`. Which contract a file is checked against comes from its own `schema` URL, per the selection rules V1-V6; a release this build does not have is reported as `unsupported schema version`, never checked against a different schema.
- **FHT and FHGM are drafts and are not supported.** They have no released contract, no `schemaVersion`, no w3id URL and no row in `schemas/versions.json`, and this library implements no draft lane for them (rule V7 gives a draft no release form). Do not describe either as supported here.
- Acceptance is the shared conformance suite, not a local one: FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification's `conformance/` vectors (291 total, vendored byte-for-byte with provenance). Current result: **228 of 228 runnable vectors pass** (fasta 98/98, gfa 56/56, fhp-fasta 36/36, fhgff3 38/38). **63 are not run**: `jsonld` (37) and `microdata` (26) reader paths are not implemented and are reported as skipped, never as passes.
- The checksum is computed by `docs/FORMAT.md` R1-R5 and by `bioheaders combine` upstream — never by hand. This library can verify it and strip a header; it **cannot write or recompute a header into a file** (no `combine`). Use the Python toolkit for creating headers.
- Node only, for now. SHA-512/256 comes from `node:crypto`; WebCrypto's `subtle.digest` does not offer it, so a browser build needs a pure-JS SHA-512/256 that is not included. No browser support is claimed.
- Integers above 2^53-1 cannot be represented exactly by a JavaScript number; the reader reports them with a `precision warning` instead of pretending otherwise.
- This library is **not** the browser tooling on fhref.org and **not** `gff3-validator`'s Pyodide build. The family has ruled (fair-bioheaders.github.io#23) that the website's header validation must not be described as validation performed by JavaScript, because that page runs CPython under Pyodide. Nothing here inherits, wraps or replaces it, and those tools are not prior art for this package.
- This library does **not** validate GFF3 features. Syntax, sequence-ontology terms and biological consistency belong to `gff3-validator`; a valid FHGFF3 header says nothing about the lines under it.
- Rules it enforces are named by the shared identifiers: `R1`-`R15` (FORMAT.md), `P1`-`P2` (FHP.md), `G1`-`G3` (FHGFF3.md), `V1`-`V6` (SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md). Errors and warnings carry the rule id in the text.
- Licensed MPL-2.0, in `LICENSE` and in the `license` field of `package.json`. The `LICENSE` file carries the project's provenance split: historical USDA-ARS material stays public domain within the United States, contributions from March 2025 onward are MPL-2.0, third-party material keeps its own terms.

## Use

```js
import { inspectFile, inspectBytes, stripFile, computeChecksum, selectSchema } from 'fair-bioheaders';

const reading = inspectFile('genome.fhr.fasta');       // {valid, container, metadata, checksum, schema, warnings, errors}
if (!reading.valid) console.error(reading.errors);     // nothing throws for a non-conforming file

const plain = stripFile('genome.fhr.fasta');           // Uint8Array, header block removed, every other byte kept
```

Install from the repository until a maintainer publishes it:
`npm install github:FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools-JavaScript`.
Requires Node.js 20 or later. ESM only.

## Repository

- [README](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools-JavaScript/blob/main/README.md): scope, API table, limits, what is not implemented
- [docs/CAPABILITY.md](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools-JavaScript/blob/main/docs/CAPABILITY.md): the dependency study — exact versions, why 2020-12, the ajv configuration the released bytes force, the SHA-512/256 proof, the YAML dialect findings and the JS number pitfalls
- [docs/CONFORMANCE.md](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools-JavaScript/blob/main/docs/CONFORMANCE.md): pinned vector source, per-format results, every vector not run and why
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools-JavaScript/blob/main/AGENTS.md): rules for coding agents working in this tree
- [skills/fair-bioheaders-javascript/SKILL.md](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools-JavaScript/blob/main/skills/fair-bioheaders-javascript/SKILL.md): the same guidance as a skill
- [schemas/provenance.json](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools-JavaScript/blob/main/schemas/provenance.json): which release each bundled contract copy came from, with its SHA-256
- [conformance/provenance.json](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools-JavaScript/blob/main/conformance/provenance.json): the pinned revision of the shared vector suite

## The standard, which is what to cite

- [FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification): released schemas, format rules and conformance vectors
- [Format rules R1 to R15](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification/blob/main/docs/FORMAT.md): header block placement, checksum coverage, encoding, `>`/`@` escaping, link schemes, extension fields
- [Schema versions and selection](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification/blob/main/docs/SCHEMA-VERSIONS.md): versioning policy and how a `schema` URL selects a schema
- [FHP](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification/blob/main/docs/FHP.md) and [FHGFF3](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification/blob/main/docs/FHGFF3.md) type rules
- [The shared llms.txt](https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification/blob/main/llms.txt): the family-level summary, including the Python toolkit that writes headers
- Paper: Molik, Feltus & Yocum, [doi:10.1093/bib/bbae122](https://doi.org/10.1093/bib/bbae122)

## Not implemented, not claimed

`combine`/writing any form; JSON-LD and HTML microdata readers; JSON-LD expansion or
compaction; a command-line interface; streaming or gzip-writing output; browser or
Deno/Bun support; TypeScript declaration files; GFF3 feature validation; FHT or
FHGM at any version; the V7 draft lane; the "near-miss schema URL" advisory warning
that fair-bioheaders 0.10.0 added. Nothing is published: no npm package, no
release, no tag, no DOI, no registry entry.
